definitions.explanation: On alternate days: one day yes, the next day no.

examples.japanese: {一日|いちにち}おき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
⟦ごみ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一日|いちにち}おき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I put the rubbish out every other day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧、{一日|いちにち}おき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: I was told to take the medicine every other day, not every day.

notes:
⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧ + 〜おき (at intervals of). Used with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ as an adverb ({一日|いちにち}おき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧) or with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ before a noun.

USAGE:
The same pattern works with other units: ⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧おき (every other week), ⟦{二日|ふつか}→二日：02954_futsuka⟧おき (every third day, with two days skipped between).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{隔日|かくじつ}→隔日：16891_kakujitsu⟧: every other day; formal and written
- ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧: every day
